sources.name: MarkTechPost
sources.summary: Microsoft AI has released MAI-Cyber-1-Flash, its first model built specifically for cyber defense. It is a 137B total, 5B active sparse MoE fine-tune of MAI-Code-1-Flash with a 256k context window. The model does not ship as a standalone endpoint — it runs inside MDASH, Microsoft's multi-model agentic scanning harness, where it handles up to 90% of tasks and pushes the system to 95.95% on CyberGym. The post Microsoft AI Releases MAI-Cyber-1-Flash: A 5B-Active-Parameter Cyber Model That Pushes MDASH to 95.95% on CyberGym appeared first on MarkTechPost .
